## Description
`r gsub("(<doi:)(.+)(>)", "[doi:\\2](https://doi.org/\\2)", gsub("\\n", " ", packageDescription("ggmultiglyph", fields = "Description")))`

```{r readme-plot, echo=FALSE, out.width='80%', fig.height=10, fig.width=8, out.width='80%', dpi = 250}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggmultiglyph))

library(grid)
library(gridExtra)


gp_vec <- gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")

z_grid <- c(hp = 3, drat = 3, wt = 2,
            qsec = 2, vs = 3, am = 4,
            gear = 2, carb = 3)

clrs <- mapply(function(a, b) rep(a, b),
               RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
               z_grid)
clrs <- unlist(clrs)


dotgrob <-
  dotglyphGrob(x = 0.6, z = z_grid, radius = 2,
               mirror = TRUE,
               fill = clrs)

dot_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.1, label = "Dot Profile Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

metrogrob <- metroglyphGrob(x = 0.3,
  z = c(0.24, 0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 0.6, 0.33, 0.6, 0.25) * 0.5,
  size = 25, col.ray = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  lwd.ray = 10,
  fill = "gray80")

metro_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.9, label = "Metroglyph", gp = gp_vec)

piegrob <- pieglyphGrob(x = 0.7,
  z = c(0.24, 0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 0.6, 0.33, 0.6, 0.25) * 0.75,
  size = 25, fill = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))

pie_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.1, label = "Pie Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

profilegrob <- profileglyphGrob(x = 0.4,
  z = c(0.24, 0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 0.6, 0.33, 0.6, 0.25) * 0.75,
  size = 25, fill = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))

profile_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.9, label = "Profile Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

stargrob <- starglyphGrob(x = 0.7,
  z = c(0.24, 0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 0.6, 0.33, 0.6, 0.25) * 0.75,
  size = 25, col.whisker = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  lwd.whisker = 5, lwd.contour = 0.5)

star_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.1, label = "Star Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

tilegrob <- tileglyphGrob(x = 0.3,
  z = c(4, 3.5, 2.7, 6.8, 3.4, 5.7, 4.3),
  size = 8, nrow = 2,
  fill = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(7, "Dark2"))

tile_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.9, label = "Tile Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

flowergrob <- flowerglyphGrob(x = 0.7,
  z = c(0.24, 0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 0.6, 0.33, 0.6, 0.25) * 0.75,
  size = 25, fill = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  petal.base.shape = 2,
  petal.width = 0.3, scale.area = TRUE, scale.length = FALSE)

flower_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.1, label = "Flower Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

bubblegrob <- bubbleglyphGrob(x = 0.3,
                              z = c(0.24, 0.3, 0.8, 1.4, 0.6, 0.33, 0.6, 0.25),
                              size = 5, fill = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"), 
                              layout = "pack")

bubble_ant <- textGrob(x = 0.9, label = "Bubble Glyph", gp = gp_vec)

grid.arrange(arrangeGrob(dotgrob, dot_ant, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(metro_ant, metrogrob, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(piegrob, pie_ant, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(profile_ant, profilegrob, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(stargrob, star_ant, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(tile_ant, tilegrob, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(flowergrob, flower_ant, nrow = 1),
             arrangeGrob(bubble_ant, bubblegrob, nrow = 1),
             nrow = 8)

rm(dotgrob, dot_ant, metro_ant, metrogrob, piegrob, pie_ant,
   profile_ant, profilegrob, stargrob, star_ant,
   tile_ant, tilegrob, flowergrob, flower_ant,
   gp_vec, z_grid)

```

## Installation

The package can be installed from CRAN as follows:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Install from CRAN
install.packages('ggmultiglyph', dependencies=TRUE)
```

The development version can be installed from github as follows:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Install development version from Github
devtools::install_github("aravind-j/ggmultiglyph")
```

## CRAN checks

```{r, echo = FALSE}
pkgname <- "ggmultiglyph"

osdf <-
  rbind(data.frame(OS = "Linux", 
                   Flavour = c("r-devel-linux-x86_64-debian-clang",
                               "r-devel-linux-x86_64-debian-gcc", 
                               "r-devel-linux-x86_64-fedora-clang",
                               "r-devel-linux-x86_64-fedora-gcc", 
                               "r-patched-linux-x86_64",
                               "r-release-linux-x86_64")),
        # data.frame(OS = "Solaris", 
        #            Flavour = c("r-patched-solaris-x86")),
        data.frame(OS = "Windows", 
                   Flavour = c("r-devel-windows-x86_64", 
                               "r-release-windows-x86_64",
                               "r-oldrel-windows-x86_64")),
        data.frame(OS = "macOS", 
                   Flavour = c("r-release-macos-x86_64", 
                               # "r-release-macos-arm64",
                               # "r-oldrel-macos-arm64",
                               "r-oldrel-macos-x86_64")))

chkurl <- paste("https://cran.r-project.org/web/checks/check_results_",
                pkgname, ".html", sep = "")
library(RCurl)

if (url.exists(chkurl)) {
  chklink <- paste("(", chkurl,  ")", sep = "")
} else {
  chklink <- "(https://cran.r-project.org/web/checks/check_results_j.aravind_at_icar.org.in.html)"
}

osdf$`CRAN check` <- paste("[![CRAN check - ", osdf$Flavour, "]",
                           "(https://badges.cranchecks.info/flavor/",
                           osdf$Flavour, "/", pkgname, ".svg)]",
                           chklink,
                           sep = "")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results='asis', eval=FALSE}
library(kableExtra, warn.conflicts = FALSE)

kosdf <- kbl(osdf[, c("Flavour", "CRAN check")], row.names = FALSE)

kosdf2 <- kable_styling(kosdf, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                        full_width = F, position = "left")

# os_index <- c(6, 1, 3, 2)
os_index <- c(6, 3, 2)

names(os_index) <- c(paste("[![Linux](https://shields.io/badge/Linux--9cf?logo=Linux&style=social)]",
                           chklink, sep = ""),
                     # paste("[![Solaris](https://shields.io/badge/Solaris--9cf?logo=Oracle&style=social)]",
                     #       chklink, sep = ""),
                     paste("[![Windows](https://shields.io/badge/Windows--9cf?logo=Windows&style=social)]",
                           chklink, sep = ""),
                     paste("[![MacOS](https://shields.io/badge/MacOS--9cf?logo=Apple&style=social)]",
                           chklink, sep = ""))

pack_rows(kosdf2, index = os_index)

```

## Citing `ggmultiglyph`
To cite the methods in the package use:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
citation("ggmultiglyph")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
detach("package:ggmultiglyph", unload = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggmultiglyph))
cit <- citation("ggmultiglyph")
# yr <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")
# cit[1]$year <- yr
# oc <- class(cit)
# 
# cit <- unclass(cit)
# attr(cit[[1]],"textVersion") <- gsub("\\(\\)",
#                                      paste("\\(", yr, "\\)", sep = ""),
#                                      attr(cit[[1]],"textVersion"))
# class(cit) <- oc
if (is.null(cit[1]$year)) {
  cit[1]$year <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")
  cit$textVersion <- gsub("()", 
                          paste("(", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), ")", sep =""), 
                          cit$textVersion, fixed = TRUE)
}
cit
```
